_schema_notes.coverage: Authoritative schema for all DID formats — DD Form 1664 (pre-2014) and free-text (post-2014 MIL-STD-963C)
_schema_notes.did_format: Set to 'dd_form_1664' or 'free_text'. Determines which fields are expected to be populated.
_schema_notes.963c_compliant: True if the DID was prepared under MIL-STD-963C (2014 or later). False for older DIDs.
_schema_notes.reserved_fields: Fields marked RESERVED are present in one format but not the other. Always include them — set to empty string or empty array when not applicable.
_schema_notes.preparation_instructions: Official MIL-STD-963C name for what was previously called 'requirements'. Contains the numbered sections of the DID. All section numbers are normalized to strictly numeric dot-notation (1, 1.1, 1.1.1). Letter-based source numbering (2.a, 3.1.b) is converted to numeric equivalents (2.1, 3.1.2).
_schema_notes.asterisk: True if the requirement number is followed by * in the source document (conditional requirement).

title: Verification Analysis Record
summary: The Verification Analysis Record documents problems and improvements noted during test procedure verification, the final step before finalizing test procedures developed under the DOD-STD-2106(NAVY) engineering process.
description_purpose: The verification analysis record provides documentation of problems and improvements noted during test procedure verification. Verification is the last step prior to finalizing test procedures developed under the DOD-STD-2106(NAVY) engineering process.
application_interrelationship:
7.1 This Data Item Description describes data required by 5.2.11.2 of DOD-STD-2106(NAVY).
7.2 The verification analysis record is completed during test procedure verification and provides information on suggested procedure changes and improvements.
7.3 Related Data Item Description is: DI-QCIC-80206, Shipboard Industrial Test Procedure
distribution_statement: DISTRIBUTION STATEMENT A: Approved for public release; distribution is unlimited.

preparation_instructions.title: Source document.
preparation_instructions.content: The applicable issue of the documents cited herein, including their approval date, and dates of any applicable amendments and revisions shall be as reflected in the contract.

preparation_instructions.title: Format and content.
preparation_instructions.content: The verification analysis record shall be completed on NAVSEA Form 3990/2. Content of the verification record shall be in accordance with the requirements of 5.2.11.1 of DOD-STD-2106(NAVY). Handwritten entries are acceptable if clear and legible.
